




name: X17-Surface Build Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:  # ✅ jobs must be at the top level (no indentation under "on:")
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Set up ROS 2 (Jazzy)
      - name: Set up ROS 2
        uses: ros-tooling/setup-ros@v0.7
        with:
          required-ros-distributions: jazzy

      - name: Setup ROS Jazzy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install -y software-properties-common
          sudo add-apt-repository universe
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install -y curl gnupg2 lsb-release
          sudo curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ros/rosdistro/master/ros.key -o /usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg
          echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg] http://packages.ros.org/ros2/ubuntu $(lsb_release -sc) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ros2.list > /dev/null
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install -y ros-jazzy-desktop
          echo "source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc
          source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3-pip wget
          python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools
          pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt

      - name: Install MediaMTX
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/install_mediamtx.sh
          scripts/install_mediamtx.sh

      - name: Build workspace
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/build.sh
          scripts/build.sh

      - name: Start and check ROS 2 nodes
        run: |
          set -e
          source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash

          echo "Starting ROS 2 nodes..."
          chmod +x scripts/run.sh
          ./scripts/run.sh &
          RUN_PID=$!

          # Wait for nodes to start
          sleep 15

          echo "Checking running nodes..."
          NODE_LIST=$(ros2 node list || true)
          echo "$NODE_LIST"

          EXPECTED_NODES="/heartbeat_monitor.py"

          for NODE in $EXPECTED_NODES; do
            if [[ ! "$NODE_LIST" =~ "$NODE" ]]; then
              echo "❌ ERROR: $NODE node not found"
              kill $RUN_PID || true
              exit 1
            fi
          done

          echo "✅ All nodes successfully launched."
          kill $RUN_PID || true
      
      - name: Success
        run: echo "✅ Success!"
